blocks.tamil_translation: “O daughter of Siddiq, that is not the meaning. The meaning of the ayah is: they are those who fast, pray and give charity. But they fear that their good deeds may not be accepted (because of some evil deed); it is they who hasten to gather good deeds, and it is they who race ahead towards those good deeds,” Rasulullah ﷺ replied.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سَعْدٍ ﵁ قَالَ:سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: اِنَّ اللهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ التَّقِيَّ الْغَنِيَّ الْخَفِيَّ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب الدنيا سجن للمؤمن...، رقم:٧٤٣٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Sa'd (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say, “Allah Ta'ala loves the servant who is God-fearing, free of need from people, and unknown.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ سَعِيْدِ نِ الْخُدْرِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَوْ اَنَّ رَجُلاً عَمِلَ عَمَلاً فِيْ صَخْرٍ لَا بَابَ لَهَا وَلَا كُوَّةَ، خَرَجَ عَمَلُهُ اِلَي النَّاسِ كَائِنًا مَا كَانَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) says that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Even if a person sits inside a rock that has neither a door nor an opening and does some deed, it will certainly become known to people, whether that deed is good or evil!”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- When every deed will become known to people, what benefit is there for one who engages in religious works to ruin his deed by seeking name and fame? And what use is it for an evil person to hide his evil? Both will certainly come out among people.
(Tarjuman-us-Sunnah)
